rules.name: UnitRepairFactor
rules.comment: Used along with strength step value to calculate the cost of a single repair step. (Cost / (MaxStrength / UnitRepairStrengthStep)) * UnitRepairFactor

rules.name: UnitRepairStrengthStep
rules.comment: The amount of strength to give a unit on each repair step.

rules.name: AircraftRepairFactor
rules.comment: Used along with strength step value to calculate the cost of a single repair step. (Cost / (MaxStrength / AircraftRepairStrengthStep)) * AircraftRepairFactor

rules.name: AircraftRepairStrengthStep
rules.comment: The amount of strength to give a aircraft on each repair step.
